mathematical_assessment: The four preimage formulas follow directly from adjacent midpoint cells and ties-to-even. Negative thresholds use real ordering; zero encodings are correctly merged for comparisons.
W iff g>-tau-h_minus(a), with equality accepted exactly when a even; PRIMARY strict iff g>=tau+2^-87 because the frozen tau significand is odd.
SECONDARY strict uses h_plus(a) and equality accepted exactly when a odd; a=F is handled separately as false.
g>=-tau is sufficient for machine weak by monotonicity, but machine weak does not imply ideal weak. Both nonimplication counterexamples for strict rules are valid.
Worst local maximum/other minimum is monotone worst corner. The universal Cartesian-box necessity is valid; correlations may make this test conservative.
Gap-only machine transfer explicitly requires independent forward-error bounds and scale information for the SECONDARY half-spacing. No norm/SVD correctness is inferred from float(norm(...,2)).
Finite exact point decision and guarded finite semidecision for shrinking analytic bounds are distinguished. Fixed residual scalar errors and resource caps are not assumed to vanish.

independent_synthetic_verification.standalone_python_source:
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from functools import lru_cache
import json, hashlib, time
from pathlib import Path
START=time.monotonic()
MAX=0x7fefffffffffffff
SIGN=1<<63
@lru_cache(None)
def val(k):
    s=-1 if k&SIGN else 1
    k=k&(~SIGN)
    e=k>>52
    m=k&((1<<52)-1)
    assert e<2047
    if e:
        m += 1<<52
        p=e-1023-52
    else: p=-1074
    return s*(Q(m<<p) if p>=0 else Q(m,1<<(-p)))
F=val(MAX)
def round_bits_nonnegative(x):
    assert Q(0)<=x<=F
    lo,hi=0,MAX
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi+1)//2
        if val(mid)<=x: lo=mid
        else:hi=mid-1
    if val(lo)==x or lo==MAX:return lo
    distance_low=x-val(lo)
    distance_high=val(lo+1)-x
    return lo if distance_low<distance_high or (distance_low==distance_high and lo%2==0) else lo+1
def rn(x):
    return val(round_bits_nonnegative(x)) if x>=0 else -val(round_bits_nonnegative(-x))
def adjacent(k,step):
    if val(k)==0:return 1 if step>0 else SIGN|1
    out=k+(step if not k&SIGN else -step)
    assert out&(~SIGN)<=MAX
    return out
def midpoint(k,step):return (val(k)+val(adjacent(k,step)))/2
def table(x,k,rel):
    even=not(k&1)
    lo,hi=midpoint(k,-1),midpoint(k,1)
    return {'ge':x>lo or (x==lo and even),
            'gt':x>hi or (x==hi and not even),
            'le':x<hi or (x==hi and even),
            'lt':x<lo or (x==lo and not even)}[rel]
tau_k=0x3ddb7cdfd9d7bdbb
tau=val(tau_k)
positive=[0,1,2,3,(1<<52)-1,1<<52,(1<<52)+1,
          tau_k-1,tau_k,tau_k+1,0x3fefffffffffffff,
          0x3ff0000000000000,0x3ff0000000000001,MAX-1]
thresholds=positive+[SIGN|k for k in positive if k]+[SIGN]
preimage_checks=0
for k in thresholds:
    low,high=midpoint(k,-1),midpoint(k,1)
    step=min(val(k)-low,high-val(k))/4
    for x in [low-step,low,low+step,val(k),high-step,high,high+step]:
        if abs(x)>F:continue
        got=rn(x)
        expected={'ge':got>=val(k),'gt':got>val(k),'le':got<=val(k),'lt':got<val(k)}
        for rel,b in expected.items():
            assert table(x,k,rel)==b,(k,x,rel)
            preimage_checks+=1
assert tau == Q(7737125245533627,77371252455336267181195264)
assert tau_k%2==1 and val(tau_k+1)-tau==Q(1,1<<86)
cut=tau+Q(1,1<<87)
assert rn(cut)>tau
bits=set(positive+[MAX, round_bits_nonnegative(Q(1)-tau),round_bits_nonnegative(Q(1)+tau)])
predicate_checks=0
def predicates(ak,bk):
    a,b=val(ak),val(bk)
    assert a>=0 and b>=0 and b+tau<=F
    g=b-a
    wp=g> -tau-(a-val(adjacent(ak,-1)))/2 or (g==-tau-(a-val(adjacent(ak,-1)))/2 and ak%2==0)
    pp=g>=cut
    sp=False if ak==MAX else (g>tau+(val(adjacent(ak,1))-a)/2 or (g==tau+(val(adjacent(ak,1))-a)/2 and ak%2==1))
    return wp,pp,sp
for ak in bits:
    for bk in bits:
        a,b=val(ak),val(bk)
        if b+tau>F:continue
        wp,pp,sp=predicates(ak,bk)
        assert wp==(a<=rn(b+tau))
        assert pp==(rn(b-a)>tau)
        assert sp==(a<rn(b-tau))
        if b-a>=-tau:assert wp
        predicate_checks+=3
u=Q(1,1<<86)
a=3*u/4;b=tau+u
assert b-a>tau and not(rn(b-a)>tau) and a<rn(b-tau)
a2=rn(Q(1)-tau)
assert Q(1)-a2>cut and not(a2<rn(Q(1)-tau))
a3=rn(Q(1)+tau)
assert a3>Q(1)+tau and a3<=rn(Q(1)+tau)
box_checks=0
boxes=[(0,2),(tau_k-1,tau_k+1),(round_bits_nonnegative(Q(1)-tau)-1,round_bits_nonnegative(Q(1)-tau)+1),
       (0x3ff0000000000000,0x3ff0000000000002)]
for al,au in boxes:
    for bl,bu in boxes:
        corner=predicates(au,bl)
        for which in (1,2):
            corner_answer=corner[0] and corner[which]
            universal=all((p[0] and p[which]) for ak in range(al,au+1) for bk in range(bl,bu+1) for p in [predicates(ak,bk)])
            assert corner_answer==universal
            box_checks+=1
assert (val(1<<52)-val((1<<52)-1))/2==(val((1<<52)+1)-val(1<<52))/2
# Explicit source-operand equalities at the delicate cuts.
ak=round_bits_nonnegative(Q(1,1<<87))
bk=tau_k+1
assert val(bk)-val(ak)==cut and predicates(ak,bk)[1]
source_tie_checks=1
for ak in [0x3de0000000000000,0x3de0000000000001]:
    a=val(ak)
    bp=a+tau+(val(adjacent(ak,1))-a)/2
    bk=round_bits_nonnegative(bp)
    assert val(bk)==bp and predicates(ak,bk)[2]==bool(ak&1)
    bm=a-tau-(a-val(adjacent(ak,-1)))/2
    bk=round_bits_nonnegative(bm)
    assert val(bk)==bm and predicates(ak,bk)[0]==(ak%2==0)
    source_tie_checks+=2
print(json.dumps({"method":"independent integer-lattice nearest-neighbor bisection and exact Fraction arithmetic; no author oracle imported",
"rounding_preimage_comparisons":preimage_checks,
"point_predicate_comparisons":predicate_checks,
"universal_small_box_comparisons":box_checks,
"counterexamples":3,"explicit_point_source_midpoint_ties":source_tie_checks,"minimum_normal_spacing_clarification_confirmed":True,
"pass":True,"wall_seconds":time.monotonic()-START,
"actual_HH_runs":0,"native_builds":0,"proof_authority":False},indent=2))
